# Local 360° panorama test fixtures

These files were downloaded from Wikimedia Commons for local prototype testing. They are not LocalSpot content and must not be uploaded to R2.

- `35C3_Panorama.jpg` — Simon Waldherr, [source file](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:35C3_Panorama.jpg), CC BY-SA 4.0. The image is an aerial equirectangular panorama of the 35C3 event.
- `Wikimania_2023_360_group_photo.jpg` — Omar sansi, [source file](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wikimania_2023_360_group_photo.jpg), CC BY-SA 4.0. The image is a 360° event group photograph.

If a modified copy is shared outside this local test workspace, preserve attribution and comply with the applicable ShareAlike license.
